confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'based on your description, the pump itself is the prime suspect'; 'a coin, button, or hair grip—is wedged against the pump's impeller'

blockingLoop.evidence: Impeller torch check requested three times after customer said they would not do it; drain hose check repeated and drain and spin re-requested

rationale: The assistant fixated on a jammed pump impeller from debris, despite the filter holding only fluff and the customer repeatedly declining to look inside. It re-asked the same impeller check and the drain and spin test, ignoring the customer's answers. It never asked for the flash pattern or the full model number, and never kept the pressure switch or control board as live possibilities. The engineer suggestion came only at the end and was framed around a presumed pump blockage rather than genuine uncertainty. No part was recommended and the safety advice (unplug) was fine.
